145:72.en: 「If I have no choice, I'll do it...!」

145:132.en: 「I chose to do this. I can't run!」

145:175.en: 「I'll do what only I can do!」

145:210.en: 「This is... what I have to do!」

alternatives: I have no choice but to fight!
I've got no choice but to fight!

145:645.en: 「I have to get close to it...!」

145:1081.en: 「Are they... trying to wipe us out?」

145:1116.en: 「I can fight if I read its pattern!」

145:1157.en: 「Even if it's huge, I have to fight!」

145:1231.en: 「I have to do this here and now!」

145:1266.en: 「No one else...! I have to do it!」

145:1594.en: 「I can't let them do any more...!」

145:1805.en: 「I don't want to lose anyone else!」

145:1997.en: 「I can at least draw their fire...!」

145:2020.en: 「I'll hold them back with the EVA!」

145:2162.en: 「Can I only endure this for now...?」

145:2193.en: 「No! I've lost sight of the enemy!」

145:2649.en: 「If I can block it with the field...!」

145:2888.en: 「Even the AT Field can't stop it?!」

145:3026.en: 「Everyone else is fighting! So am I!」

145:3111.en: 「What is this...?! This is all wrong!」

145:3146.en: 「What do I do?!\nWhat do I do?!」

145:3248.en: 「No, I don't want to give up...!」

145:3308.en: 「I can't lose in a place like this!」

145:3461.en: 「No! I don't want to give up yet...!」

145:3502.en: 「No...! I can't hold out any longer!」

145:3597.en: 「$$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$, $$碇シンジ$$!」

145:4129.en: 「Oh, I hear that's not in this one.」

145:4162.en: 「I can't settle on the team lineup...」

145:4632.en: 「So we can't reach them from here...!」

145:6025.en: 「$$シンジ$$'s not alone. We're with him.」

145:6098.en: 「Once again, with all of Japan's energy, our wishes... humanity's future... the lives of every living thing that survived... I entrust them to you. Good luck.」
